Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: add database diagnostics and improved error handling

- Add /api/debug/db-check endpoint for diagnosing D1 connection issues
- Improve /api/evaluations/tree with detailed logging and error messages
- Add error state UI to evaluations page with retry functionality
- Create comprehensive troubleshooting guide for Cloudflare deployment

This helps diagnose and fix the issue where evaluation data wasn''t displaying
on Cloudflare deployment despite data existing in D1.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: resolve JSON serialization error for large responseContent

Problem: API returned unterminated JSON at position 115MB because 
responseContent contained unescaped special characters.

Solution:
- Remove responseContent from tree API response \(too large to serialize\)
- Add /api/debug/tree-simple for lightweight data loading
- Keep responseContent in database for later retrieval via separate API

The responseContent can be fetched separately if needed via a dedicated
result API endpoint.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
